240-969-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5256-6972-7804.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

215-527-1879.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-1879.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7510.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hancock enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Hancock from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hancock enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 7, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
413-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 5 instead.

777-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
777-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

789-2438-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
789-2438-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

145-4499-7008.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
145-4499-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}.
When Badgermole Cub enters, it triggers, earthbending Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Badgermole Cub.
Repeat from step 2.

3963-6913-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1746-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3372-4050-6006-6965.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-6006-6965.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

549-2685-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-2919-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating an artifact creature token.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2638-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3362-3734.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phyrexian Metamorph
3362-3734.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phyrexian Metamorph's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-3263-6259-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

2961-5686-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2961-5686-6553.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

856-2267-2438-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-2438-4321.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1329-1477-2178-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1477-2178-3652.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1429-4050-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4050-5402-5929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

453-2047-6190.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight creatures if Mechanized Production is attached to a creature other than Deceiver of Form, or nine creatures otherwise.
You have an artifact creature card on top of your library.
453-2047-6190.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Deceiver of Form triggers, revealing the top card of your library and causing all other creatures you control to become a copy of that creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Shadow of the Second Sun triggers, causing you to get an additional beginning phase after this one.
At the beginning of the extra upkeep phase, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

5803-5891.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5803-5891.description:
Cast Join Shields by paying {3}{G}{W}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Join Shields.
Resolve the copy of Join Shields, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

930-2594-3781-4050.description:
Activate Winding Canyons' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-2929.notablePrerequisites:
You control six or more enchantments.
You control a nontoken enchantment creature.
You have an enchantment creature card in hand.
You have enough mana available to cast the enchantment creature in hand.
2232-2929.description:
Cast the enchantment creature by paying its mana cost.
When the enchantment creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning another nontoken enchantment creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting an enchantment creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2136-4688-4690.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four basic lands.
2136-4688-4690.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Phylath.
Put all the Phylath tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Phylath tokens enters-the-battlefield abilities trigger, creating at least twenty 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

2034-2459-4535-5224.description:
Cast Rograkh.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rograkh.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Rograkh dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand.
Repeat.

3094-3557-5034.notablePrerequisites:
You control artifacts that can tap to add at least {2}.
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Brago.
3094-3557-5034.description:
Deal combat damage with Brago.
Brago triggers.
In response, activate artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Brago's triggered ability.
Resolve the copied triggered ability, blinking Lithoform Engine, the artifacts that tapped for mana, and any number of nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-2858-3142-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Flame's Catalyst onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Flame's Catalyst dealing damage to each opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Flame's Catalyst to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2441-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Rasputin Dreamweaver.
Activate Rasputin Dreamweaver's first activated ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Eldrazi Displacer any number of times choosing any targets.
